h5BWyHp6unSxLoPpskILog.en: From May 2025 to August this year, Europe cumulatively reported 341 confirmed cases, nearly half of which occurred after May this year; most patients were infants and children under 4. The United Kingdom (474 cases) and the Netherlands (106 cases) reported the most. Recently, Belgium has reported more than 300 cases due to contaminated eggs. EFSA estimates that about 91,000 cases are reported across Europe each year, with an estimated annual economic burden, including healthcare and productivity losses, of €3 billion. Authorities advise people eating out to avoid undercooked meat, raw eggs and unpasteurised dairy products.

_O23ZrgT4z3_SBc_TIlw-Q.zh: 全球自2022年截至今年7/31累計145國/地區報告19萬683例確定病例,其中529例死亡。 今年7月共計32國家/地區報告1,370例確定病例,其中7例死亡(CFR:0.5%),以馬達加斯加(703例)、安哥拉(138例)、中國(88 例)、剛果⺠主共和國(55例)及肯亞(55例)為多,74.8%病例來自非洲地區。相較今年6月,全球病例數下降12.5%,僅非洲區呈上升趨勢,其餘地區下降;東南亞區及東地中海區則無通報病例。 全球已有68個國家/地區曾通報檢出Clade Ib確定病例,近6週(7/6-8/16)共有22國報告病例,其中15國出現本土社區傳播疫情,分布於非洲6國(馬達加斯加、安哥拉、肯亞、剛果⺠主共和國、南蘇丹、蒲隆地)及歐洲9國(葡萄牙、德國、法國、英國、愛爾蘭、荷蘭、義大利、瑞士及捷克)。 另馬達加斯加自2025年12月起迄今爆發全球最大規模Ib型疫情。
_O23ZrgT4z3_SBc_TIlw-Q.en: Globally, since 2022 and as of 31 July this year, 145 countries and territories have cumulatively reported 190,683 confirmed cases, including 529 deaths. In July this year, 32 countries and territories reported 1,370 confirmed cases, including 7 deaths (CFR 0.5%); the largest numbers were in Madagascar (703), Angola (138), China (88), the DRC (55) and Kenya (55), and 74.8% of cases came from Africa. Compared with June this year, global cases fell by 12.5%; only Africa showed an increase, while other regions declined, and no cases were reported from South-East Asia or the Eastern Mediterranean region. A total of 68 countries and territories have ever reported confirmed clade Ib cases. In the past six weeks (6 July–16 August), 22 countries reported cases, of which 15 have local community transmission: six in Africa (Madagascar, Angola, Kenya, the DRC, South Sudan and Burundi) and nine in Europe (Portugal, Germany, France, the United Kingdom, Ireland, the Netherlands, Italy, Switzerland and Czechia). Madagascar has been experiencing the largest clade Ib outbreak in the world since December 2025.

qJsuxC3sFtQ8l_zF_ML__Q.zh: 英國爆發3起群聚事件,其中最大規模群聚事件截至8/28累計報告474例確定病例,其中1例死亡。本次疫情呈現罕見的大規模且同一時間感染之趨勢,疑感染源為餐飲業、學校及養老院等通路使用之進口雞蛋,當局評估在供應鏈未溯源確認前,疫情將持續攀升,呼籲⺠眾外食應避免半熟或生蛋料理。
qJsuxC3sFtQ8l_zF_ML__Q.en: The UK has had three outbreak clusters; the largest had cumulatively reported 474 confirmed cases as of 28 August, including one death. This outbreak shows a rare pattern of large numbers of infections occurring at the same time. The suspected source is imported eggs used by channels such as food-service businesses, schools and care homes for the elderly. Authorities assess that cases will continue to rise until the supply chain is traced and confirmed, and urge people eating out to avoid half-cooked or raw egg dishes.

Wwrw6L_51EGLFcYDs-Oukg.zh: 英國2025年報告6,069例病例,高於2024年疫情(5,450例),且為2016年以來最高,分布以倫敦為多(1,568例)。近年疫情上升除與檢驗技術進步,提高敏感度外,國際旅遊復甦、氣候變遷亦為可能因素。當局提醒旅客應食用熟食及避免飲用未煮沸自來水,以降低感染風險。
Wwrw6L_51EGLFcYDs-Oukg.en: The UK reported 6,069 cases in 2025, higher than the 5,450 cases in 2024 and the highest since 2016; London accounted for the most (1,568 cases). Besides improved test sensitivity, the recovery of international travel and climate change are also possible factors in the recent rise. Authorities remind travellers to eat cooked food and avoid drinking untreated tap water to reduce the risk of infection.

j2Ara_A-etjEi8K3d9nqog.zh: 全球自2022年迄2026年6月底,共145個國家/地區累計報告188,847例確定病例及521例死亡,致死率約0.3%。目前疫情風險主要集中於非洲,馬達加斯加自2025年12月起爆發目前全球最大規模疫情,已有61%行政區受影響,近期檢驗陽性率達74%,疫情尚未獲控制;剛果⺠主共和國則持續有Clade Ia及Ib共同流行,惟監測及檢驗量能下降,可能低估實際疫情規模;巴基斯坦年初發生Clade Ib院內群聚,34例確定病例中有8例嬰幼兒死亡。另全球於英國、印度及卡達發現3例Clade Ib/IIb重組病毒株,目前尚無證據顯示其傳播力或疾病嚴重度增加,仍須持續監測。WHO評估維持全球風險為中,主要以高風險性行為族群傳播為主,該族群風險為中,一般大眾則為低。
j2Ara_A-etjEi8K3d9nqog.en: Globally, from 2022 to the end of June 2026, 145 countries and territories have cumulatively reported 188,847 confirmed cases and 521 deaths, a case fatality rate of about 0.3%. Current risk is concentrated mainly in Africa. Madagascar has been experiencing the world's largest current outbreak since December 2025; 61% of its administrative areas have been affected, the recent test positivity rate has reached 74%, and the outbreak is not yet under control. The DRC continues to see co-circulation of clade Ia and Ib, but declining surveillance and testing capacity may underestimate the actual scale of the outbreak. Pakistan had a clade Ib hospital cluster early this year, in which 8 of 34 confirmed cases were infants and young children who died. In addition, 3 recombinant clade Ib/IIb virus strains have been found in the United Kingdom, India and Qatar; there is currently no evidence that transmissibility or disease severity has increased, but monitoring must continue. WHO assesses the global risk as moderate. Transmission is mainly within high-risk sexual networks, where the risk is moderate; for the general public, the risk is low.

ZVUSl-BJ_A5pmKiM1wBo-w.zh: 歐洲疫情更新,自去(2025)年5月迄今年8月累計報告341例確定病例,其中至少34例住院,疫情自5月起顯著上升(新增152例),病患分布於英國(207例)、荷蘭(106例)、比利時(15例)、德國(6 例)等7國,英國研判疑感染源為進口雞蛋,荷蘭懷疑感染源為雞肉。全基因定序顯示,本次菌株與2025年於荷蘭通報之雞蛋與家禽疫情相關。
ZVUSl-BJ_A5pmKiM1wBo-w.en: Europe update: from May 2025 to August this year, 341 confirmed cases have been cumulatively reported, of which at least 34 were hospitalised. The outbreak has risen markedly since May (152 new cases), with patients distributed across seven countries, including the UK (207 cases), the Netherlands (106), Belgium (15) and Germany (6). The UK suspects imported eggs as the source of infection, and the Netherlands suspects chicken meat. Whole-genome sequencing shows that this strain is related to egg and poultry outbreaks reported in the Netherlands in 2025.

_AdJ1EUQ7QRg3lnDofaNkA.zh: 英國自2025年8/11截至今年8/13累計報告207例感染特定單一菌株之確定病例,其中38%住院,並有1例死亡,疫情多發生於今年7月,病患分布以英蘭為多,基因定序顯示存在共同感染源 。疑感染源為受汙染之進口雞蛋,當局評估實際感染病例數可能更高,呼籲幼童等高風險族群應食用具安全認證之雞蛋。
_AdJ1EUQ7QRg3lnDofaNkA.en: From 11 August 2025 to 13 August this year, the UK cumulatively reported 207 confirmed cases infected with one specific strain; 38% were hospitalised and 1 died. The outbreak occurred mainly in July this year, and cases were concentrated in England. Genome sequencing shows a common source of infection. The suspected source is contaminated imported eggs. Authorities assess that the actual number of infections may be higher, and call on high-risk groups such as young children to eat eggs with safety certification.

nVUsMQAYFu4ybG_wrTQxoA.zh: 全球自2022年截至今年6/30累計145國/地區報告18萬8,565例確定病例,其中521例死亡。 今年6月共計33國家/地區報告1,128例確定病例,其中9例死亡(CFR:0.8%),以馬達加斯加(546例)、美國(111例)、剛果⺠主共和國(86例)、英國(46例)及葡萄牙(45例)為高,64%病例來自非洲地區。相較今年5月,美洲區及東南亞區病例數呈上升趨勢,其餘地區疫情則下降;東地中海區則無通報病例。哥斯大黎加、迦納及立陶宛通報首例Ib型病例;幾內亞比索首度通報3例IIb型病例。 非洲地區近6週(6/8-7/19)共計10國報告1,112例確定病例,其中12例死亡(CFR:1.1%),以馬達加斯加(940例)、安哥拉(57例)、肯亞(48例)、剛果⺠主共和國(30例)及喀麥隆(24例)為高。 非洲以外地區,共11國報告Ib型社區傳播;近6週報告Ib型病例最多國家為葡萄牙(60例),其次為英國(31例)、泰國(29例)、法國(18例)及西班牙(16例)。 馬達加斯加自2025年12月起爆發全球最大規模Ib型疫情,截至7/19,累計報告2,921例確定病例及18例死亡(CFR:0.6%)。疫情擴及全國61%行政區(70/115),主要影響15-49歲族群。雖已推動MVA-BN疫苗接種(89,723人施打第1劑),惟因檢測陽性率由65%上升至74%,以及面臨疫苗缺貨、冷鏈物流、醫療量能與風險溝通等挑戰,疫情迄未受到控制。 安哥拉自今年5月中旬起疫情升溫,截至7/19累計108例確定病例及1例死亡(CFR 0.9%),主要集中於Cabinda省(佔80%),52%病例為20-29歲族群,其中女性及女童比例高達66%,當局已啟動相關防治措施。
nVUsMQAYFu4ybG_wrTQxoA.en: Globally, from 2022 through 30 June this year, 145 countries and territories have reported 188,565 confirmed mpox cases, including 521 deaths. In June this year, 33 countries and territories reported 1,128 confirmed cases, including 9 deaths (CFR: 0.8%). The highest numbers were in Madagascar (546), the United States (111), the Democratic Republic of the Congo (86), the United Kingdom (46) and Portugal (45), and 64% of cases came from the African Region. Compared with May this year, case numbers rose in the Region of the Americas and the South-East Asia Region and declined in other regions; the Eastern Mediterranean Region reported no cases. Costa Rica, Ghana and Lithuania reported their first clade Ib cases, and Guinea-Bissau reported 3 clade IIb cases for the first time. In the African Region, over the past 6 weeks (8 June–19 July), 10 countries reported 1,112 confirmed cases, including 12 deaths (CFR: 1.1%). The highest numbers were in Madagascar (940), Angola (57), Kenya (48), the Democratic Republic of the Congo (30) and Cameroon (24). Outside Africa, 11 countries have reported clade Ib community transmission. Over the past 6 weeks, the countries reporting the most clade Ib cases were Portugal (60), the United Kingdom (31), Thailand (29), France (18) and Spain (16). Madagascar has experienced the world's largest clade Ib outbreak since December 2025. As of 19 July, 2,921 confirmed cases and 18 deaths (CFR: 0.6%) have been reported cumulatively. The outbreak has spread to 61% of the country's administrative areas (70 of 115), mainly affecting people aged 15–49 years. Although MVA-BN vaccination has begun (89,723 people have received the first dose), the test positivity rate has risen from 65% to 74%, and challenges including vaccine shortages, cold chain logistics, health system capacity and risk communication remain, so the outbreak is not yet under control. Angola's outbreak has intensified since mid-May this year. As of 19 July, 108 confirmed cases and 1 death (CFR: 0.9%) have been reported cumulatively, mainly concentrated in Cabinda Province (80%). Of cases, 52% are aged 20–29 years, and females and girls account for as much as 66%. Authorities have launched related prevention and control measures.

AlaE-i0gGzL9kCgWA9_F9g.zh: 英國牛津大學疫苗團隊啟動Bundibugyo伊波拉候選疫苗之第一期(Phase 1)人體試驗,將評估在50名健康成年人之安全性及免疫反應(年齡介於18至55歲間)。 針對無症狀之高風險接觸者,實驗性抗病毒藥物obeldesivir之暴露後預防(EBO-PEP)臨床試驗計畫,已於7/14在剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)伊圖里省重災區(布亞Bunia及魯瓦姆帕拉Rwampara 衛生區)啟動召募計畫,預計召募近1,000 名參與者(須為成人或12歲以上兒童)。
AlaE-i0gGzL9kCgWA9_F9g.en: The University of Oxford vaccine team in the United Kingdom has launched a Phase 1 human trial of the Bundibugyo Ebola candidate vaccine, which will assess safety and immune response in 50 healthy adults aged 18 to 55 years. For asymptomatic high-risk contacts, a clinical trial of post-exposure prophylaxis (EBO-PEP) with the experimental antiviral obeldesivir began recruitment on 14 July in the hard-hit Ituri Province of the DRC (Bunia and Rwampara health zones). Nearly 1,000 participants are expected to be enrolled (adults or children aged 12 years and older).

KhKSOeYBHdArwCvsWF8y9A.zh: 美國疫情持續擴大,今年截至6月,累計報告2,231例確定病例,接近去年全年2,289例,多數為19 歲以下(70%)族群,且有高達93%患者未接種疫苗或接種狀態不明。疫情主要集中於南卡羅來納州(670例),其次為猶他州(516例)、德州(182例)及佛羅里達州(141)例。 英國近期疫情上升,今年截至7/6,累計報告883例確定病例及3 例死亡,病例主要分布於倫敦(52%),其次為西密德蘭郡(17%) 。該國疫苗覆蓋率偏低與倫敦為國際主要交通樞紐,是引發此波疫情主因。該國優先針對免疫功能不全者、未滿 1 歲嬰兒及孕婦等高風險族群進行補接種計畫。 馬爾地夫今年截至7/11累計報告121例確定病例,近期單週新增55例確定病例。疫情集中於首都馬列(Malé),且多數為15至35 歲族群。該國採取擴大疫苗接種,並進行接觸者追蹤與基因定序等防疫措施。
KhKSOeYBHdArwCvsWF8y9A.en: The US outbreak continues to rise. As of June this year, 2,231 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively, approaching last year's full-year total of 2,289. Most (70%) are aged under 19 years, and as many as 93% of patients were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination status. The outbreak is concentrated in South Carolina (670 cases), followed by Utah (516), Texas (182) and Florida (141). The UK has seen a recent rise in cases. As of 6 July this year, 883 confirmed cases and 3 deaths have been reported cumulatively. Cases are mainly in London (52%), followed by West Midlands County (17%). Low vaccination coverage in the country and London's status as a major international transport hub are the main drivers of this wave. The country is prioritizing catch-up vaccination for high-risk groups, including immunocompromised people, infants under 1 year and pregnant women. Maldives has reported 121 confirmed cases cumulatively this year as of 11 July, with 55 new confirmed cases added in the most recent week. Cases are concentrated in the capital, Malé, and most are aged 15 to 35 years. The country is expanding vaccination and carrying out contact tracing and genomic sequencing.

KVndG6H0ESMvTZdnm_c-4A.zh: 英國、奧地利、比利時等共10個歐州國家今年截至5月累計報告109例病例,其中1例死亡、18例住院,病患以女性、成人為多,經調查感染源為苜蓿芽種子,由印度進口並分銷歐洲各地,各國已要求廠商將產品下架,ECDC評估此事件對於經常食用者的風險為低至中。
KVndG6H0ESMvTZdnm_c-4A.en: Ten European countries, including the United Kingdom, Austria and Belgium, reported 109 cases cumulatively this year through May, including 1 death and 18 hospitalizations. Patients are mainly female and adults. The source of infection was identified as alfalfa sprout seeds imported from India and distributed across Europe. Countries have required manufacturers to withdraw the products from sale. The ECDC assesses the risk of this event to frequent consumers as low to moderate.

qKUxc6-Q6_UeTClgmVK8Jw.zh: 每月更新:  全球自2022年截至今年3/31累計144國/地區報告18萬2,945例確診病例,其中,至少503例死亡。 今年3月共計48國家/地區報告1,235 例新增確診病例,其中5例死亡(CFR 0.4%),70.4%的病例來自非洲地區,相較今年2月,東地中海及西太平洋區病例數上升,其餘地區疫情下降,哥倫比亞、丹麥、厄瓜多和新加坡通報首例 Ib 型病例。 非洲地區近6週(2026/3/9-4/19)共計16國通報969例確診病例,其中3例死亡(CFR 0.3%),以馬達加斯加、剛果民主共和國、幾內亞、肯亞、蒲隆地為高;非洲以外地區,阿根廷、丹麥、德國、巴基斯坦、葡萄牙、新加坡、西班牙及英國已持續出現Ib型社區傳播。 巴基斯坦信德省通報一起院內群聚事件(前已掌握),傳播原因主要為共用保溫箱、氧氣設備及設備表面受污染。在3至4月期間,該省9縣(/30縣)共29例確診與8例死亡(CFR 28%),死亡個案均為6個月以下嬰兒,基因定序確認為Ib型變異株。
qKUxc6-Q6_UeTClgmVK8Jw.en: Monthly update: globally, since 2022 and as of 31 March this year, 144 countries and territories have reported 182,945 confirmed cases cumulatively, of which at least 503 died. In March this year, 48 countries and territories reported 1,235 new confirmed cases, including five deaths (CFR 0.4%). 70.4% of cases came from the African region. Compared with February, cases rose in the Eastern Mediterranean and Western Pacific regions and fell in other regions. Colombia, Denmark, Ecuador and Singapore reported their first clade Ib cases. In the African region, over the past six weeks (9 March–19 April), 16 countries reported 969 confirmed cases, including three deaths (CFR 0.3%), with the highest numbers in Madagascar, the DRC, Guinea, Kenya and Burundi. Outside Africa, Argentina, Denmark, Germany, Pakistan, Portugal, Singapore, Spain and the United Kingdom have continued to show clade Ib community transmission. Sindh Province in Pakistan reported a hospital cluster (already known), with transmission mainly attributed to shared incubators and oxygen equipment and contaminated equipment surfaces. In March and April, the province's nine of 30 districts recorded 29 confirmed cases and eight deaths (CFR 28%). All deaths were in infants under six months, and genetic sequencing confirmed a clade Ib variant.

zCvmneUgfXZOwnfAQs-cIA.zh: 英國西南部多塞特郡韋茅斯地區報告 3 例確定病例,分別為就讀巴德茅斯學院(2 例)及韋谷學院(1 例)年輕人,病患分別於 3/20-4/15 期間確診為 B 型,均屬同一亞型,惟與近期肯特郡疫情之亞型不同,2 例巴德茅斯學院學院具相互接觸史,另 1 例病患尚未確認其流行病學關聯,病患皆已接受治療且恢復良好,當局已提供密切接觸者抗生素。另表示 B 型腦膜炎雙球菌可能於韋茅斯地區之青少年流行,建議提供該地區年輕人抗生素及疫苗。
zCvmneUgfXZOwnfAQs-cIA.en: In Weymouth, Dorset, in south-west England, three confirmed cases were reported among young people attending Budmouth College (two cases) and Weymouth College (one case). Patients were confirmed as serogroup B between 20 March and 15 April, all belonging to the same subtype, which differs from the subtype in the recent outbreak in Kent. Two of the Budmouth College cases had known contact with each other; the epidemiological link for the third case has not yet been confirmed. All patients have been treated and have recovered well. Authorities have provided antibiotics to close contacts. They say serogroup B meningococcal disease may be circulating among adolescents in the Weymouth area, and recommend that antibiotics and vaccines be offered to young people there.

oY8PHyY1gfEPGAOyW1qObw.zh: 日本疫情急遽上升,第 15 週單週新增 56 例確定病例,今年截至4/15 累計報告 299 例,其中 30 例為境外移入病例,感染國家以印及紐西蘭為多,年齡層以 15-29 年齡層為多(占 50%),分布以東京都 108 例、神奈川縣 31 例及鹿兒島縣 28 例為多,61%病患未接種疫苗或接種史不明,當局呼籲民眾確認兒童按時接種疫苗,另前往流行地區應採取相關防疫措施。 英國今年截至 4/13 累計報告 407 例確定病例,病例數以倫敦 229 例及西密德蘭郡(West Midlands)100 例為多,另所有地區皆有報告至少 1 例確定病例。該國去(2024)年報告 959 例確定病例。 歐盟今年 2 月共計 11 國報告 139 例確定病例,以義大利(63 例)、西班牙(36 例)為多。近 12 個月(2025/3/1-2026/2/28)共計 30 國報告 4,623 例病例,其中 6 例死亡,病例數以羅馬亞(1,587 例)、法國(754 例)、義大利(534 例)為多,其中 79.9%病患未接種疫苗。
oY8PHyY1gfEPGAOyW1qObw.en: Japan's outbreak has risen sharply: 56 confirmed cases were reported in week 15 alone, and as of 15 April this year, 299 cases had been reported cumulatively, of which 30 were imported. The countries of infection were mainly India and New Zealand. Those aged 15–29 accounted for the largest share (50%). Cases were concentrated in Tokyo Metropolis (108), Kanagawa Prefecture (31) and Kagoshima Prefecture (28). 61% of patients were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination history. Authorities urge the public to confirm that children are vaccinated on schedule and to take appropriate precautions when travelling to epidemic areas. The UK reported 407 confirmed cases cumulatively this year as of 13 April. Cases are concentrated in London (229) and West Midlands County (100), and every region has reported at least one confirmed case. The UK reported 959 confirmed cases last year (2024). In February this year, 11 EU countries reported 139 confirmed cases, mainly Italy (63) and Spain (36). In the past 12 months (1 March 2025 to 28 February 2026), 30 countries reported 4,623 cases, including six deaths, with the largest numbers in Romania (1,587), France (754) and Italy (534); 79.9% of patients were unvaccinated.

PI2yJ38lGhlfp4DqyhWMFA.zh: 英國今年截至 3/23 報告 8 例確定病例,所有病患均居住/工作/曾到訪過倫敦西北部或西南部地區,且細菌序列類型均相同,另有 13 例病例持續調查中,當局已啟動流行病學等調查,以確認是否有潛在共同感染源。
PI2yJ38lGhlfp4DqyhWMFA.en: As of 23 March this year, the United Kingdom has reported 8 confirmed cases. All patients lived in, worked in, or had visited north-west or south-west London, and all share the same bacterial sequence type. A further 13 cases are under investigation. Authorities have launched epidemiological and other investigations to determine whether there is a potential common source of infection.

SIGR50MKplPxkwHqzYpK_w.zh: 疫情更新:  今年第 11 週(3/16-22)全球陽性率上升為 2.47%,其中東南亞區署、東地中海區署陽性率明顯增加。 德國疫情呈下降,目前處低點,第 13 週新增 282 例病例;變異株以 NB.1.8.1(68%)為主,另變異株 BA.3.2 占比上升,從今年9-10 週的 5%,上升至第 10-11 週的 11%。 英國疫情略升,第 13 週實驗室檢測陽性率略增至 2.1%。變異株以 XFG 占大宗,BA.3 於 2/16-3/1 占比為 2.13%。 GISAID 去年 12 月迄今的病毒株定序資料顯示,BA.3.2 多數易感宿主為年輕族群,其中,愛爾蘭高達 38.8%及法國 27%病例為 18 歲以下族群;美國 49.1%及盧森堡 23.4%病例為 10 歲以下族群,與其他變異株感染病患的年齡層分布顯著不同。  評估與建議:  近期全球流行變異株以 XFG 占比最高(占 31.44%),其次為NB.1.8.1(30.68%),BA.3.2 占比上升至 12.5%。WHO 公布之 COVID-19 全球長期快速風險評估(第 9 版),評估對全球公共衛生的整體風險屬中等。鑒於自然感染與疫苗帶來的群體免疫力提升,以及臨床治療的進步,全球住院與死亡數自 2022 年以來明顯下降。 目前多數流行變異株為 Omicron JN.1 及其衍生亞型,雖具備免疫逃脫能力,惟不至於造成疾病嚴重度增加,然有 6%的有症狀病例出現長新冠症狀;現階段 COVID-19 尚未形成穩定季節性流行規律,多數國家已減少常規檢測通報,汙水與定醫監測成為重要的補充監測方式。 WHO 指出,目前疫苗仍能有效預防重症與死亡,並建議優先保護高風險族群、與流感疫苗共同施打;同時透過《冠狀病毒疾病威脅管理策略計劃》呼籲各國整合防治計畫,持續加強監測、保護高風險族群、維持醫療與公衛韌性,並落實風險溝通。
SIGR50MKplPxkwHqzYpK_w.en: Epidemic update: In week 11 of this year (16–22 March), the global positivity rate rose to 2.47%, with notable increases in the WHO South-East Asia and Eastern Mediterranean regions. Germany's epidemic is declining and is currently at a low point, with 282 new cases reported in week 13. NB.1.8.1 (68%) remains the predominant variant, while the share of BA.3.2 has risen from 5% in weeks 9–10 of this year to 11% in weeks 10–11. The UK's epidemic has risen slightly, and laboratory test positivity increased slightly to 2.1% in week 13. XFG accounts for the largest share of variants, and BA.3 accounted for 2.13% during 16 February–1 March. Sequencing data in GISAID since December last year show that most BA.3.2 infections occur in young people: 38.8% of cases in the Republic of Ireland and 27% in France were under 18 years, and 49.1% of cases in the United States and 23.4% in Luxembourg were under 10 years, a significantly different age distribution from patients infected with other variants. Assessment and recommendations: XFG currently accounts for the highest share of circulating variants globally (31.44%), followed by NB.1.8.1 (30.68%), and BA.3.2 has risen to 12.5%. WHO's global long-term rapid risk assessment for COVID-19 (9th edition) rates the overall risk to global public health as moderate. Given population immunity from natural infection and vaccination, and advances in clinical treatment, global hospitalizations and deaths have declined markedly since 2022. Most circulating variants are Omicron JN.1 and its descendant subtypes; although they have immune escape capacity, they do not cause greater disease severity, but 6% of symptomatic cases develop long COVID symptoms. COVID-19 has not yet established a stable seasonal pattern, and most countries have reduced routine testing and reporting, so wastewater and sentinel physician surveillance have become important supplementary methods. WHO notes that current vaccines remain effective at preventing severe disease and death, and recommends prioritizing high-risk groups and co-administration with influenza vaccines. Through its Strategic Plan for Coronavirus Disease Threat Management, WHO calls on countries to integrate prevention and control plans, continue strengthening surveillance, protect high-risk groups, maintain health system and public health resilience, and implement risk communication.

GmQvkuk1n4YSJS05K7Vxmg.zh: 每月更新:  全球自2022年截至今年2/28累計144國/地區報告18萬1千餘例確診病例,其中,至少492例死亡。 今年2月共計46國家/地區報告1,184 例新增確診病例,其中4例死亡,58.6%來自非洲地區,相較今年1月,歐洲區病例數上升,其餘地區疫情下降或持平,阿根廷、奧地利及中非共和國通報首例 Ib 型病例。 非洲地區近6週(2026/2/1-3/15)共計17國通報907例確診病例,其中7例死亡,以馬達加斯加、剛果民主共和國、肯亞、蒲隆地及賴比瑞亞為高;非洲以外地區,奧地利、比利時、葡萄牙、西班牙及英國已持續出現Ib型社區傳播。
GmQvkuk1n4YSJS05K7Vxmg.en: Monthly update: Since 2022 and up to 28 February this year, 144 countries and regions have reported more than 181,000 confirmed cases cumulatively, of which at least 492 died. In February this year, 46 countries and regions reported 1,184 new confirmed cases, including 4 deaths; 58.6% came from the African Region. Compared with January this year, case numbers rose in the European Region, while other regions declined or held steady. Argentina, Austria and the Central African Republic reported their first clade Ib cases. In the African Region over the past six weeks (1 February–15 March 2026), 17 countries reported 907 confirmed cases, including 7 deaths; the highest numbers were in Madagascar, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Kenya, Burundi and Liberia. Outside Africa, Austria, Belgium, Portugal, Spain and the United Kingdom have continued to report clade Ib community transmission.

a0UGgLmEWt9Gbjh21Bdv9Q.zh: 英國肯特郡迄3/23累計報告20例實驗室確診及3例可能病例,死亡2例,目前疫苗接種已超過8,000人,接受抗生素使用已超過12,100人,流行菌株經基因定序後確認為B群 Neisseria meningitidis ST‐485,屬已知「高度侵襲性(hyperinvasive)」克隆群之一。 越南今年於河內、河寧、老街及安江等地爆發疫情,並已發布警報,其中安江省富國特區於3/16報告1例死亡病例,為11歲女學生,疫苗接種史不明,且未曾與確診病例接觸,雖接受治療,惟病情仍迅速惡化後死亡,其1位同學出現症狀並已接受治療,家人及鄰居等密切接觸者均已接受預防性抗生素或接種疫苗,迄未通報其他病例。另該國去(2025)年累計報告95例病例且為B型,其中3例死亡,疫情為2024年 (21例)的4.5倍。
a0UGgLmEWt9Gbjh21Bdv9Q.en: Kent County, United Kingdom, has reported 20 laboratory-confirmed cases and 3 probable cases as of 23 March, with 2 deaths. More than 8,000 people have been vaccinated, and more than 12,100 people have received antibiotics. Genomic sequencing confirmed the epidemic strain as serogroup B Neisseria meningitidis ST-485, one of the known hyperinvasive clonal complexes. Viet Nam has had outbreaks this year in Hanoi, Ha Nam, Lao Cai and An Giang and has issued an alert. In Phu Quoc Special Zone of An Giang Province, one death was reported on 16 March in an 11-year-old female student with unknown vaccination history and no contact with a confirmed case; although she received treatment, her condition deteriorated rapidly and she died. One of her classmates developed symptoms and has been treated. Close contacts, including family members and neighbours, have received preventive antibiotics or vaccination, and no other cases have been reported. Viet Nam reported 95 cases last year, all serogroup B, of which 3 died; this year's outbreak is 4.5 times the 21 cases reported in 2024.

vD1fm-uoA9Q99hkmMUfrOg.zh: 英國肯特郡疫情更新,迄3/20累計報告34例,其中23例經實驗室確診,另有11例仍在調查中,死亡2例,目前疫苗接種已超過4,500人,接受抗生素使用已超過10,500人,初步分析此菌株可能屬於Group B type 485,惟仍持續確認中。當局評估帶原者出遊,可能造成其他地區出現病例,持續推動疫苗及抗生素措施,並密切監測疫情。
vD1fm-uoA9Q99hkmMUfrOg.en: Kent County, UK, has updated its outbreak information: as of 20 March, 34 cases have been reported cumulatively, of which 23 were laboratory-confirmed and 11 are still under investigation, with 2 deaths. More than 4,500 people have been vaccinated and more than 10,500 have received antibiotics. Preliminary analysis suggests the strain may belong to Group B type 485, though this is still being confirmed. Authorities assess that carriers who travel could lead to cases in other regions, and continue to promote vaccination and antibiotic measures and to monitor the situation closely.

eknmSNxvDHM-comQMFBTIQ.zh: 英國東南部肯特郡報告13例確定病例,其中11例住院,2例死亡,經調查部分病患曾於3/5-7至坎特伯里(Canterbury)之俱樂部(Club Chemistry),病患主要為19-21歲大學生,多名病患為肯特大學學生,當局已提供至俱樂部人員及密切接觸者預防性抗生素治療,另呼籲民眾倘出現疑症狀,應立即就醫。 剛果民主共和國中部省曼姆博(mangembo)區報告24例病例,其中9例死亡(CFR:37%),3例經實驗室確診,主要為13-24歲年齡族群,此波疫情起源於2月下旬,於短時間內發現多名中學生出現類症狀。
eknmSNxvDHM-comQMFBTIQ.en: Kent County in south-east England has reported 13 confirmed cases, of which 11 were hospitalized and 2 died. Investigations found that some patients had visited a club, Club Chemistry, in Canterbury between 5 and 7 March. Patients were mainly university students aged 19–21 years, and several were students at the University of Kent. Authorities have provided preventive antibiotic treatment to club staff and close contacts, and urge the public to seek medical care immediately if they develop suspicious symptoms. In Mangembo district of the central province of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, 24 cases were reported, including 9 deaths (CFR: 37%), with 3 laboratory-confirmed. Most were aged 13–24 years. The outbreak began in late February, and several secondary school students were found with similar symptoms within a short period.

YzgEhyG92969MYquvlsclw.zh: 越南南部頭頓市(Vung Tau)3/9報告108例病例,病患最早於3月初發病,51件病患檢體中有28件(占54%)呈沙門氏菌陽性,迄未出現嚴重病例,疑感染源為某商店販售之越南麵包。 英國今年截至2月底累計報告84例病例,病患年齡中位數為33歲,此波疫情自1月起持續上升,經當局調查疑感染源為某大型連鎖超市的醃製豬肉。
YzgEhyG92969MYquvlsclw.en: In Vung Tau City in southern Viet Nam, 108 cases were reported on 9 March. The earliest patients fell ill in early March. Of 51 patient specimens, 28 (54%) tested positive for Salmonella. No severe cases have occurred so far. The suspected source of infection is Vietnamese bread sold at a shop. The United Kingdom reported 84 cases cumulatively this year through the end of February. The median age of patients is 33 years, and this wave has risen continuously since January. Authorities' investigation suggests that the suspected source of infection is cured pork sold by a large chain supermarket.

SydaT1vhYVwa3HYYx6oXHA.zh: 每月更新:  全球自2022年截至今(2026)年1/31累計144國/地區報告17萬9千餘例確診病例,其中,至少483例死亡。 今年1月共計50國家/地區報告1,334 例新增確診病例,其中3例死亡,66%來自非洲地區,相較去年12月,歐洲區病例數上升,其餘地區疫情下降。全球各區疫情皆呈下降趨勢,葛摩及法屬留旺島通報首例 Ib 型病例。 非洲地區近6週(2026/1/5-2/15)共計20國通報1,142例確診病例,其中4例死亡,以剛果民主共和國、幾內亞、馬達加斯加、賴比瑞亞及迦納為高;非洲以外地區,法國、葡萄牙及西班牙持續出現Ib型社區傳播。 WHO 於 2 月發布全球快速風險評估,性接觸仍是跨國擴散主因,全球傳播風險評估為中,對MSM群體(尤其未固定性伴侶族群)傳播風險為中,對一般民眾傳播風險為低。 全球目前累計報告2例Ib 及IIb 型基因片段之重組病毒株,分別為於英國報告具東南亞旅遊史,以及印度報告具阿拉伯半島國家旅遊史之病患,基因定序顯示其為相同重組病毒株。WHO表示實際病例數可能多於目前通報數,惟重組病毒株臨床症狀與一般分支相,且皆無重症,接觸者追蹤亦未發現續發病例,評估整體風險維持不變。
SydaT1vhYVwa3HYYx6oXHA.en: Monthly update: since 2022 and up to 31 January this year, 144 countries and regions have reported more than 179,000 confirmed cases cumulatively, of which at least 483 died. In January this year, 50 countries and regions reported 1,334 new confirmed cases, including 3 deaths; 66% came from the African Region. Compared with December last year, case numbers rose in the European Region, while other regions declined. Case numbers are declining in all regions globally. Comoros and Réunion reported their first clade Ib cases. In the African Region over the past six weeks (5 January–15 February 2026), 20 countries reported 1,142 confirmed cases, including 4 deaths; the highest numbers were in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Guinea, Madagascar, Liberia and Ghana. Outside Africa, France, Portugal and Spain have continued to report clade Ib community transmission. WHO issued a global rapid risk assessment in February: sexual contact remains the main driver of cross-border spread. The global transmission risk is assessed as moderate; the risk for MSM populations, especially those with non-stable sexual partners, is moderate, and the risk for the general public is low. Globally, two recombinant viruses carrying Ib and IIb gene segments have been reported cumulatively: one in a patient in the United Kingdom with a Southeast Asia travel history, and one in a patient in India with a travel history to Arabian Peninsula countries. Genetic sequencing shows they are the same recombinant strain. WHO notes that actual case numbers may be higher than reported, but the clinical symptoms of the recombinant virus are consistent with ordinary lineages, none have been severe, and contact tracing has found no secondary cases; the overall risk assessment remains unchanged.

o-qonNIuJd3w3wregW3V1Q.zh: 日本疫情略降,第7週(2/9-15)感染性腸胃炎定醫平均報告7.98例,為5年同期最高,致病原多為諾羅病毒。 韓國疫情略降,第7週報告613例病例,惟仍處高點,為近5年最高。 英國疫情下降,第6-7週累計報告981例病例,惟仍高於近5年同期平均。
o-qonNIuJd3w3wregW3V1Q.en: Japan's outbreak is declining slightly. In week 7 (9–15 February), the average number of sentinel reports of infectious gastroenteritis was 7.98 cases, the highest for the same period in five years; the pathogen is mainly norovirus. South Korea's outbreak is declining slightly: it reported 613 cases in week 7; it remains at a high point and is the highest in five years. The United Kingdom's outbreak has declined: it reported 981 cases cumulatively in weeks 6–7, but remains higher than the five-year average for the same period.

rYCJnMBVInLfXoX2bT_puQ.zh: 哈薩克疫情上升,今 (2026) 年截至2/20報告3,343例確定病例,其中84.2%為14歲以下兒童,另77.6%為未接種疫苗兒童,分布於阿斯塔納和阿拉木圖等9個地區。當局已發布防疫命令,包括擴大免疫接種運動、暫時禁止未接種疫苗兒童進入學校和幼稚園,以及強制醫護人員接種疫苗。 美國疫情持續,今(2026)年截至2/19共26州累計報告982例確定病例,其中38例住院,該國94%病患未接種疫苗或接種史不明, 病例數以南卡羅來納州報告632例確定病例為多,其次為猶他州(117例)及佛羅里達州(64例),其中佛羅里達州病患主要與柯里爾郡(Collier)之聖母瑪利亞大學相關,該校已加強相關疫情防治措施。 墨西哥疫情持續,今年截至2/23累計報告4,497例確定病例,其中5例死亡,病例數以中西部哈利斯科州(2,662例)、南部恰帕斯州(393例)為多。該國自去(2025)年年初爆發疫情,2025年累計報告6,444例確定病例,其中27例死亡,其中以1-4歲嬰兒為多(1,548例)。 英國北倫敦地區爆發疫情,英蘭地區今年已累計96例確診病例,主要分布於倫敦及西密德蘭區域,病例以10歲以下兒童為多,2成之感染兒童住院治療中,所有住院兒童均未完全接種疫苗。當局已設立臨時疫苗接種所,鼓勵補接種疫苗。
rYCJnMBVInLfXoX2bT_puQ.en: Kazakhstan's outbreak is rising. As of 20 February this year, 3,343 confirmed cases have been reported, of which 84.2% were children under 14 years and 77.6% were unvaccinated children, distributed across nine regions including Astana and Almaty. Authorities have issued prevention orders, including expanding immunization campaigns, temporarily banning unvaccinated children from entering schools and kindergartens, and requiring health workers to be vaccinated. The United States outbreak continues: as of 19 February this year, 982 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively across 26 states, of which 38 were hospitalized; 94% of patients were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination history. Cases are concentrated in South Carolina, with 632 confirmed cases, followed by Utah (117 cases) and Florida (64 cases). Florida's patients are mainly linked to Ave Maria University in Collier County, which has strengthened outbreak prevention and control measures. Mexico's outbreak continues: as of 23 February this year, 4,497 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively, including 5 deaths; cases are concentrated in west-central Jalisco (2,662 cases) and southern Chiapas (393 cases). The outbreak in Mexico began in early last year; 6,444 confirmed cases, including 27 deaths, were reported in 2025, mainly among infants aged 1–4 years (1,548 cases). In north London, an outbreak has occurred: England has reported 96 confirmed cases so far this year, mainly in London and the West Midlands, mostly among children under 10 years. Twenty per cent of infected children are being treated in hospital, and all hospitalized children were not fully vaccinated. Authorities have set up temporary vaccination sites to encourage catch-up vaccination.

ol-lkLPd6NRSS7tk1OsWIA.zh: 英國疫情更新,自2025年10月起迄今年2/8累計報告158例病例,其中112例有維德角共和國旅遊史,並已報告至少4例死亡案例,當局已發布旅遊建議,呼籲遊客勤洗手、避免生食。另荷蘭、瑞典、法國及愛爾蘭亦有報告與維德角共和國相關之病例。
ol-lkLPd6NRSS7tk1OsWIA.en: The UK's outbreak update: from October 2025 to 8 February this year, 158 cases have been reported cumulatively, of which 112 had travel history to the Republic of Cabo Verde (Cape Verde), and at least 4 deaths have been reported. Authorities have issued travel advice calling on travellers to wash their hands frequently and avoid eating raw food. Cases linked to Cape Verde have also been reported in the Netherlands, Sweden, France and Ireland.

1KsclMl6KY7wL6LjcV63MQ.zh: 英國疫情上升,今年前2週疫情較2025年12月底增加47%,惟仍在季節性的流行範圍內,疫情多發生於學校、辦公室及醫院;當局已發布警告,呼籲有相關症狀之民眾應於症狀消除後,仍留在家中休養至少2天
1KsclMl6KY7wL6LjcV63MQ.en: The United Kingdom's situation is rising. In the first two weeks of this year, the number of cases increased by 47% compared with late December 2025, though it remains within the seasonal range. Outbreaks mainly occur in schools, offices and hospitals. Authorities have issued a warning, urging people with relevant symptoms to stay at home and rest for at least 2 days after symptoms have resolved.

R07oxC-uYwofyX-ew0jY3Q.zh: 本月更新:  全球自2022年5月截至今年11/30累計142國/地區報告17萬5千餘例確診病例,其中至少467例死亡(CFR:0.27%);今年截至11/30累計99國/地區報告5萬餘例確診病例,其中206例死亡(CFR:0.41%)。 今年11月共計48國家/地區報告2,150 例新增確診病例,其中 5例死亡(CFR:0.27%),68%來自非洲地區,相較10月,歐洲區與西太平洋區病例數上升,其餘地區疫情下降。 非洲地區近6週(11/2–12/14)共計19 國通報1,435例確診病例,其中7 例死亡(CFR:0.5%),其中以剛果民主共和國(427例)、幾內亞(330例)、賴比瑞亞(176例)、肯亞(142例)及迦納(107例)為高,除賴比瑞亞外,其餘近期病例數呈下降趨勢,另剛果民主共和國多省同時流行Ia及Ib型,部分省分受安全情勢與人口流動影響監測能力,病例數有低估情形。 非洲以外地區,羅馬亞通報首例 Ib 型境外移入病例,病患為成年男性,於今年8月確診,曾至中國且具高風險行為,入境後即住院隔離,境內未發現接觸者,後續亦無通報病例;西班牙及荷蘭持續出現Ib型社區傳播;英國12/2通報1例境外移入病例,同時檢出Ib 及IIb 型基因片段之 MPXV 重組病毒株,病況為輕症,現階段對該重組病毒株之流行範圍仍缺乏足夠資訊。  評估與建議: WHO於9/5終止「國際關注公共衛生緊急事件(PHEIC)」,但因非洲不同基因型持續流行且監測及診斷能力不足,資金及社區資源缺乏,仍將全球傳播風險評估為中等。此次由於無症狀感染者和疫區旅遊者病例未即時發現,導致Ib型傳播風險持續,非洲外的義大利、荷蘭、葡萄牙、西班牙和美國已被列為Ib型社區傳播區。評估對一般民眾傳播風險為低,惟對MSM群體為中,尤其未固定性伴侶族群,建議各國提高檢驗能力,並完整疫調追蹤,呼籲高風險者接種疫苗。
R07oxC-uYwofyX-ew0jY3Q.en: Monthly update: since May 2022 and up to 30 November 2025, 142 countries and areas have reported more than 175,000 confirmed cases globally, including at least 467 deaths (CFR: 0.27%). In 2025 up to 30 November, 99 countries and areas reported more than 50,000 confirmed cases, including 206 deaths (CFR: 0.41%). In November 2025, 48 countries and areas reported 2,150 new confirmed cases, including 5 deaths (CFR: 0.27%); 68% came from the African Region. Compared with October, cases rose in the European and Western Pacific Regions and declined in other regions. In the African Region, over the past six weeks (2 November–14 December), 19 countries reported 1,435 confirmed cases, including 7 deaths (CFR: 0.5%). The highest numbers were in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (427), Guinea (330), Liberia (176), Kenya (142) and Ghana (107). Except for Liberia, recent case numbers have declined in these countries. In the DRC, multiple provinces are experiencing clade Ia and Ib simultaneously, and in some provinces surveillance capacity is affected by security conditions and population movement, so cases may be underestimated. Outside Africa, Romania reported its first imported clade Ib case, in an adult male diagnosed in August this year who had travelled to China and had high-risk behaviour. He was hospitalised in isolation on arrival, no contacts were identified domestically, and no further cases have been reported. Spain and the Netherlands continue to report clade Ib community transmission. On 2 December, the United Kingdom reported 1 imported case, in which a recombinant MPXV strain containing gene segments of both clade Ib and clade IIb was detected. The case was mild, and there is currently insufficient information on the spread of this recombinant strain. Assessment and recommendations: WHO ended the Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) on 5 September. However, because different genotypes continue to circulate in Africa, surveillance and diagnostic capacity are insufficient, and funding and community resources are lacking, WHO still assesses the global transmission risk as moderate. Because asymptomatic infections and cases among travellers to affected areas were not detected promptly, clade Ib transmission risk persists. Italy, the Netherlands, Portugal, Spain and the United States, outside Africa, have been listed as areas of clade Ib community transmission. The risk to the general public is assessed as low, but as moderate for men who have sex with men (MSM), particularly those with non-fixed sexual partners. Countries are advised to improve testing capacity and complete epidemiological investigation and contact tracing, and high-risk people are urged to get vaccinated.

5Whitu5ACKHqPcHlPplPdQ.zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第48週(11/24-30)全球陽性率降至4.06%,其中非洲區署陽性率增加。 中國疫情略增,第50週(12/8-14)門診陽性率為0.5%,較前1週(0.3%)略增,住院陽性率亦上升,整體疫情仍於低點,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高。 韓國疫情於低點,第50週報告住院數降至99例,陽性率略升為2%,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高。 英國疫情於低點波動,第50週實驗室監測陽性率降至1.9%,住院病例數亦下降,以變異株XFG占比最高。  評估與建議:  全球陽性率近期呈下降趨勢,其中非洲區署呈上升;近期全球流行變異株以XFG占比最高(63.6%),其次為NB.1.8.1(12.72%),新公告的BA.3.2占比提升至6.71%。鑑於COVID-19仍廣泛傳播,對高風險族群造成嚴重疾病與死亡,WHO之《冠狀病毒疾病威脅管理策略計劃》呼籲各國整合更廣泛的呼吸道和其他傳染病預防和控制計畫,強化冠狀病毒疾病威脅的整合性、永續性且具實證基礎的管理;另WHO新冠疫苗委員會於12/18公告建議以單價LP.8.1作為推薦的疫苗抗原,且JN.1譜系(JN.1或KP.2)仍為合適的替代選項。
5Whitu5ACKHqPcHlPplPdQ.en: Situation update: global test positivity fell to 4.06% in week 48 of 2025 (24–30 November), although it rose in the African Region. China's situation rose slightly: outpatient test positivity was 0.5% in week 50 (8–14 December), up slightly from 0.3% the week before, and hospital test positivity also rose; overall the situation remains at a low level, and NB.1.8.1 is the most common variant. South Korea's situation is at a low level: hospital admissions fell to 99 in week 50 and test positivity rose slightly to 2%, with NB.1.8.1 the most common variant. The United Kingdom's situation fluctuates at a low level: laboratory surveillance test positivity fell to 1.9% in week 50, hospital admissions also declined, and XFG is the most common variant. Assessment and recommendations: global test positivity has recently declined, although it has risen in the African Region. XFG is currently the most common global variant (63.6%), followed by NB.1.8.1 (12.72%), and the newly announced BA.3.2 has risen to 6.71%. Given that COVID-19 continues to spread widely and causes severe disease and deaths among high-risk groups, WHO's strategic plan for managing the threat of coronavirus disease calls on countries to integrate broader respiratory and other infectious disease prevention and control programmes, and to strengthen integrated, sustainable and evidence-based management of the coronavirus disease threat. In addition, the WHO COVID-19 vaccine committee announced on 18 December that monovalent LP.8.1 is recommended as the vaccine antigen, and the JN.1 lineage (JN.1 or KP.2) remains a suitable alternative option.

Gi_THUiL6z1tSi80-hqokQ.zh: 中國整體疫情持續上升,第49週定點ILI門急診就診率為9.9%,高於近3年同期,陽性率為49.8%,主要流行型別為A(H3N2);當局表示流感疫情處於高度流行,華東/華南/西南地區之部分省份流感活動持續上升,另陽性率呈上升趨勢,惟上升幅度趨緩,其中5-14歲年齡層之陽性率高於其他年齡層,呼籲幼托、學校及養老院等機構應加強健康監測,及早發現/處理群聚疫情,另民眾應落實個人衛生防護措施。 英國疫情上升,近1週平均每日住院人數為2,660人,較前1週增加逾50%,住院人數以75歲以上及5歲以下年齡層為多,陽性率則以5-14歲年齡層為高,當局表示疫情尚未達高點,預估短期內可能上升至逾5,000人,本流感季提早1個月爆發,主因為H3N2病毒K分支流行,致民眾缺乏既有免疫力,導致傳播加速。 加拿大疫情上升,第48週報告3,655例病例,較前1週增加逾67%,陽性率為13%,高於去年同期(2%),其中以19歲以下年齡層為高。另住院率、群聚爆發數皆呈上升,主要流行型別為A(H3N2),另該國自9/1起,已檢出47件H3N2病毒K分支,專家表示疫苗仍具保護力,呼籲民眾儘速接種疫苗。
Gi_THUiL6z1tSi80-hqokQ.en: China's overall outbreak continues to rise. In week 49, the sentinel ILI outpatient and emergency visit rate was 9.9%, higher than the same period over the past three years, with test positivity of 49.8%; A(H3N2) is the main circulating type. Authorities say influenza is at a high level of circulation; activity continues to rise in some provinces in East, South and Southwest China, and positivity is rising, though more slowly. Test positivity among those aged 5–14 is higher than in other age groups. Authorities call on nurseries, schools and elderly care homes to strengthen health monitoring and detect and manage clusters early, and urge the public to implement personal hygiene protection measures. The United Kingdom's situation is rising: the average daily number of hospitalised patients in the past week was 2,660, an increase of more than 50% from the previous week. Hospitalisations are highest among those aged 75 and over and under 5, while test positivity is highest among those aged 5–14. Authorities say the outbreak has not yet peaked and could rise to more than 5,000 patients in the short term. This flu season began a month early, mainly because the K subclade of H3N2 is circulating, leaving people without existing immunity and accelerating transmission. Canada's situation is rising: 3,655 cases were reported in week 48, an increase of more than 67% from the previous week, with test positivity of 13%, higher than the same period last year (2%), highest among those under 19. Hospitalisation rates and outbreak numbers have also risen, and the main circulating type is A(H3N2). Since 1 September, 47 H3N2 subclade K viruses have been detected in Canada. Experts say vaccines still provide protection and urge people to get vaccinated as soon as possible.

BS721gbmMSL-bbh58rZwqg.zh: 英國自10月截至12/9累計報告137例病例,病患年齡以50-59歲為主(占40.1%),並以女性為多,有9成病患有維德角共和國旅遊史,經全基因定序檢測顯示為同一感染來源。
BS721gbmMSL-bbh58rZwqg.en: The United Kingdom reported 137 cases cumulatively from October to 9 December. Patients are mainly aged 50–59 (40.1%) and are mostly female. 90% of patients had travel history to Cabo Verde, and whole-genome sequencing shows that they share the same source of infection.

JyXv9MC0L-t7czcN-tLjRQ.zh: 英國12/8報告於1名近期曾前往亞洲國家之感染者體內發現新的重組病毒,經基因定序新病毒株含有目前流行的Ib及IIb型病毒之基因片段,顯示基因突變可能性與持續基因監測的重要性。當局將持續監測並評估風險,另對符合資之群體,包括有多重性伴侶者等,實施例行疫苗接種計畫。研究顯示該疫苗保護效率約為75%至80%。
JyXv9MC0L-t7czcN-tLjRQ.en: On 8 December, the United Kingdom reported a new recombinant virus in one infected person who had recently travelled to an Asian country. Genome sequencing showed that the new strain contains gene segments from the currently circulating clade Ib and clade IIb viruses, indicating the possibility of mutation and the importance of continued genomic surveillance. Authorities will continue monitoring and risk assessment, and carry out routine vaccination for eligible groups, including people with multiple sexual partners. Studies show the vaccine's protective efficacy is approximately 75% to 80%.

qsfoozNuuBybra0OmNVp1A.zh: 英國西南部德文郡托貝區爆發疫情,截至11/30已累計報告5校19例確診病例,多數病例誤以為是濕疹而延誤就醫,目前5校皆已停課。該病透過疥蹣傳染,會寄生人體皮膚表層,進而引起搔癢及皮疹,傳染力極強,須儘速就醫用藥,當局呼籲民眾須注意症狀,並加強寢具及衣物之清洗消毒。
qsfoozNuuBybra0OmNVp1A.en: An outbreak has occurred in the Torbay area of Devon in south-west England. As of 30 November, 19 confirmed cases had been reported across five schools, and many cases were initially mistaken for eczema, delaying medical care. All five schools have suspended classes. Scabies is transmitted by mites that burrow into the surface layer of the skin, causing itching and rash. It is highly contagious and requires prompt medical treatment. Authorities urge the public to watch for symptoms and to step up washing and disinfection of bedding and clothing.

Ba0txfIw-yaEeTEb6mjKXg.zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第44週(10/27-11/2)全球陽性率6.16%,其中,非洲區署陽性率增加。 日本疫情呈下降趨勢,第45週(11/3-9)定醫平均報告數1.95,較前1週下降,分布以北海道、愛知縣為多,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高。 韓國疫情呈下降趨勢,第46(11/9-15)報告住院145例,陽性率降為4.1%,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高。 印疫情上升,第44週陽性率上升至7.46%,今年迄今累計報告505例病例。 英國疫情下降,第45週醫院監測陽性率降為5%,住院數亦下降,以變異株XFG占比最高;另本流感季75歲以上年齡層疫苗覆蓋率為56.5%。  評估與建議: 全球陽性率近期呈下降趨勢,惟非洲區署呈上升趨勢;全球流行變異株以XFG占比最高,其次為NB.1.8.1。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維持COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
Ba0txfIw-yaEeTEb6mjKXg.en: Update: The global positivity rate in week 44 of 2025 (27 October–2 November) was 6.16%, and the WHO African Region saw an increase in positivity. Japan: The outbreak is declining. In week 45 (3–9 November), the average number of reports per sentinel clinic was 1.95, lower than the previous week; cases are concentrated in Hokkaido and Aichi prefecture, and the variant NB.1.8.1 has the highest share. South Korea: The outbreak is declining. In week 46 (9–15 November), 145 hospitalizations were reported and the positivity rate fell to 4.1%; the variant NB.1.8.1 has the highest share. Indonesia: The outbreak is rising. In week 44, the positivity rate rose to 7.46%, and 505 cases have been reported cumulatively this year. United Kingdom: The outbreak is declining. In week 45, the hospital surveillance positivity rate fell to 5% and hospitalizations also declined; the variant XFG has the highest share. In addition, vaccination coverage among people aged 75 and over this flu season is 56.5%. Assessment and recommendations: Global positivity has recently been declining, but the African Region is rising. The globally circulating variant with the highest share is XFG, followed by NB.1.8.1. WHO says most countries have included COVID-19 in routine respiratory infection surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and reliable testing, treatment and vaccines to the public, maintain early warning and surveillance systems, continue tracking variant trends, report outbreak information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.

Qseo_D8EUgva8ZuXoNRbDA.zh: 日本疫情持續上升,第45週(11/2-9)定點門診平均病例數為21.82例,為本流感季首次超過20例警戒,並較去年提前1個月逾,全國病例數約為8.4萬例,為前1週病例數1.5 倍,其中,宮城/埼玉/神奈川/福島/岩手等5個都縣平均病例數超過30例。另東京都平均每家醫療機構為29.03例,兒童因重症住院人數亦上升;當局宣布,倘定點門診平均病例數持續逾30例,且治療藥物生產跟不上需求,將評估動用國家備用藥物,同時呼籲民眾落實手部衛生、佩戴口罩並評估接種疫苗。 英國疫情上升,第45周陽性率為11.9%,近期檢出以H3N2為主,另截至11/2住院率已達每10萬人3.81例,接近往年12月下旬或1月初出現之季節性高峰,當局表示今年疫情高峰提前5週,疫情可能持續更長時間。
Qseo_D8EUgva8ZuXoNRbDA.en: Japan's outbreak continues to rise. In week 45 (2–9 November), the average number of cases per sentinel outpatient clinic was 21.82, the first time this flu season has exceeded the alert level of 20, more than one month earlier than last year. The national case count was about 84,000, 1.5 times the previous week's. Five prefectures (Miyagi, Saitama, Kanagawa, Fukushima and Iwate) had average case numbers above 30 per clinic. In Tokyo, the average per medical institution was 29.03, and the number of children hospitalized with severe illness is also rising. Authorities announced that if the average per sentinel outpatient clinic remains above 30 and production of treatment drugs cannot keep up with demand, they will evaluate the use of national stockpiled drugs. They also urge people to practise hand hygiene, wear masks and consider vaccination. The UK's outbreak is rising. The positivity rate in week 45 was 11.9%, with H3N2 the predominant strain recently detected. As of 2 November, the hospitalization rate had reached 3.81 per 100,000 population, approaching the seasonal peak that usually occurs in late December or early January. Authorities said this year's peak has come five weeks earlier, and the outbreak may last longer.

TVHPzEM8IwAMP6va5L0eXA.zh: 希臘11/1報告該國首例Ib型境外移入病例,該病患曾具阿拉伯聯合大公國(UAE)旅遊史,並發生MSM行為。歐洲6國於10/11-20期間報告至少8例I型病例,分別為德國/義大利各2例、比利時/荷蘭/葡萄牙/西班牙各1例,其中2例不具旅遊史,其中3例為MSM族群,顯示可能在同性/雙性族群中尚有未發現的社交傳播鏈。當局評估MSM族群傳播風險為中,一般民眾為低。 英國自2022年截至今年10/31已累計3,732例病例,其中,累計18例Ib型病例,大多數病例與前往Ib型流行國家有直/間接關聯,該國於11/3新增報告1例Ib型病例,即具泰國旅遊史。由於近期歐、美洲MSM族群傳播風險升高,當局評估將該病輸入傳播風險從中提升至高。
TVHPzEM8IwAMP6va5L0eXA.en: Greece reported on 1 November its first imported clade Ib case; the patient had a travel history to the United Arab Emirates (UAE) and had engaged in MSM behaviour. Between 11 and 20 October, six European countries reported at least eight clade Ib cases: Germany and Italy 2 each, and Belgium, the Netherlands, Portugal and Spain 1 each. Two of these cases had no travel history, and three were in the MSM population, suggesting that undetected social transmission chains may exist among men who have sex with men and bisexual populations. Authorities assess the transmission risk in the MSM population as moderate and for the general public as low. The United Kingdom has recorded 3,732 cases cumulatively since 2022 as of 31 October this year, including 18 clade Ib cases, most of which are directly or indirectly linked to travel to countries with clade Ib transmission. The UK reported one new clade Ib case on 3 November, with a travel history to Thailand. Because the transmission risk among MSM in Europe and the Americas has recently increased, authorities have raised the assessed risk of importation and spread from moderate to high.

KuW3ik2ISS6iTDYkMbN2Ng.zh: 加拿大10/12報告105例病例,其中16例住院,病患分布於安大略及魁北克等省份;疑感染源為某生產商製造的開心果及甜點,當局已要求產品下架。 英國今年4-6月累計報告2,342例病例,雖與去年同期(2,387例)相當,但較今年1-3月(1,591例)增加47%。
KuW3ik2ISS6iTDYkMbN2Ng.en: Canada reported 105 cases on 12 October, of which 16 were hospitalized. Patients are distributed across provinces including Ontario and Quebec. The suspected source is pistachios and desserts produced by a certain manufacturer, and authorities have requested that the products be removed from shelves. The United Kingdom reported 2,342 cumulative cases in April–June this year. Although this is comparable to the same period last year (2,387 cases), it is 47% higher than January–March this year (1,591 cases).

CaIJOOhpHobgwgSBR7JpWw.zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第38週(9/15-21)全球陽性率17.41%,除歐洲及東地中海以外,各區署陽性率皆增加。 日本疫情呈下降趨勢,第39週(9/22-28)定醫平均報告數5.87,已連續2週下降,住院數呈下降趨勢,病患地理分布以東京都、神奈川縣為多,變異株以NB.1.8.1占比最高。 西太平區署第36-37週陽性率介於0-31.1%之間,其中,澳洲、柬埔寨、菲律賓及韓國疫情呈上升趨勢。 美國疫情呈下降趨勢,第39週陽性率6.7%,已連續5週下降,住院率亦下降,惟死亡率仍處高點,近期變異株以XFG占比最高(85%)。 英國疫情持續上升,惟處低點,第39週實驗監測陽性率8.4%,住院率亦上升,變異株以XFG.3(35%)及XFG(28%)占比為高。  評估與建議: 全球陽性率近期呈上升趨勢,除歐洲及東地中海以外,各區署呈上升趨勢;全球流行變異株以XFG占比最高,其次為NB.1.8.1。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維持COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
CaIJOOhpHobgwgSBR7JpWw.en: Update: The global positivity rate in week 38 of 2025 (15–21 September) was 17.41%, with positivity rising in all regional offices except Europe and the Eastern Mediterranean. Japan: The outbreak is declining. In week 39 (22–28 September), the average number of reports per sentinel clinic was 5.87, having declined for two consecutive weeks; hospitalizations are also declining. Cases are concentrated in Tokyo and Kanagawa prefecture, and the variant NB.1.8.1 has the highest share. Western Pacific regional office: In weeks 36–37, positivity rates ranged from 0 to 31.1%, and the outbreaks in Australia, Cambodia, the Philippines and South Korea are rising. United States: The outbreak is declining. The positivity rate in week 39 was 6.7%, having declined for five consecutive weeks, and hospitalization rates have also declined, but the mortality rate remains high. The variant XFG has the highest share recently (85%). United Kingdom: The outbreak continues to rise but is at a low level. The laboratory surveillance positivity rate in week 39 was 8.4%, and hospitalization rates have also risen. The variants XFG.3 (35%) and XFG (28%) have high shares. Assessment and recommendations: Global positivity has recently shown an upward trend, with increases in all regional offices except Europe and the Eastern Mediterranean. The globally circulating variant with the highest share is XFG, followed by NB.1.8.1. WHO says most countries have included COVID-19 in routine respiratory infection surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and reliable testing, treatment and vaccines to the public, maintain early warning and surveillance systems, continue tracking variant trends, report outbreak information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.

ZprFmFN5WwQ2DWvcID00nA.zh: 英國英蘭地區今年累計報告742例,該地區病例數自4月開始上升,疫情影響倫敦及西北部地區,惟於7月中旬趨緩,超過70%病例為10歲以下兒童,並報告1例兒童死亡案例。該地區去(2024)年報告2,911例,為2012年以來新高。 北美洲疫情更新,美國今年截至9/3共42州報告1,431例,並報告35起疫情 ,其中178例住院及3例死亡,3月為疫情高峰,目前已趨緩;加拿大截至8/30共10省報告4,849例,其中1例死亡,該國此次疫情流行基因型為D8型;墨西哥截至9/9報告9,439例,其中4,482例確診及19例死亡,該國各州皆有報告病例,病例數以契瓦瓦州報告逾4,100例為多。
ZprFmFN5WwQ2DWvcID00nA.en: In England, 742 cases have been reported this year. Case numbers in the region began rising in April, affecting London and the north-west, but slowed in mid-July. More than 70% of cases are children under 10 years old, and one child death has been reported. The region reported 2,911 cases last year (2024), the highest since 2012. North America outbreak update: in the United States, as of 3 September this year, 42 states had reported 1,431 cases and 35 outbreaks, of which 178 were hospitalized and 3 died; March was the peak, and the outbreak has now slowed. In Canada, as of 30 August, 10 provinces had reported 4,849 cases, including one death; the genotype circulating in this outbreak is D8. In Mexico, as of 9 September, 9,439 cases had been reported, of which 4,482 were confirmed and 19 died; cases have been reported in all states, most of them in Chihuahua State, which reported more than 4,100 cases.

0mNqZcirHeuyhNniUiZyKA.zh: PAHO於8/26發布警示,美洲地區近年病例數大幅增加,且出現抗藥性菌株,2023年僅4,100餘例病例,去(2024)年大幅增加至4.3萬餘例,今年截至7月報告1.8萬餘例及128例死亡。由於新冠疫情期間不當使用抗生素可能加速抗藥性擴散,且疫苗覆蓋率下降,目前疫苗接種率上升,惟仍低於95%建議水準。PAHO呼籲各國加強實驗室檢測、技術訓練及孕婦與醫護人員接種,並透過標準化監測系統及早偵測與應對。 日本近1週(8/18-8/24)通報2,762例,較前1週1,506例增加1,200餘例,為近3週以來首次上升,以東京都(245例)為多,其次為琦玉縣(182例)。 英國報告今年首例死亡案例,病患為嬰兒,母親未接種疫苗,該嬰兒於今年4-6月間死亡。英蘭今年第二季(4-6月)報告169例確診,較第一季333例為低,亦遠低於去年同期(7,554例)。超過70%病例為15歲以上族群,該地區去年報告11例嬰兒死亡。該國孕婦及嬰幼兒接種率近年皆下降,惟去年報告死亡病例後,孕婦接種率已回升至73%,惟仍低於峰(76%)。 法屬留旺島爆發疫情,今年迄今累計報告70例,高於去年同期17例,約36%病例為5歲以下兒童,並報告重症病例,其中1例死亡,當局呼籲接種疫苗。
0mNqZcirHeuyhNniUiZyKA.en: PAHO issued an alert on 26 August: pertussis cases in the Americas have risen sharply in recent years, and antimicrobial-resistant strains have emerged. There were only about 4,100 cases in 2023; cases rose sharply to over 43,000 last year (2024), and so far this year, as of July, over 18,000 cases and 128 deaths have been reported. Inappropriate antibiotic use during the COVID-19 pandemic may have accelerated the spread of resistance, and vaccination coverage has declined. Vaccination rates have now risen, but remain below the recommended 95%. PAHO calls on countries to strengthen laboratory testing and technical training, to vaccinate pregnant women and health workers, and to detect and respond early through standardized surveillance systems. Japan reported 2,762 cases in the past week (18–24 August), an increase of more than 1,200 from 1,506 the previous week. This is the first rise in three weeks, with Tokyo Metropolis (245 cases) the highest, followed by Saitama Prefecture (182 cases). The United Kingdom reported its first death this year, an infant whose mother was unvaccinated; the infant died between April and June this year. In England, 169 confirmed cases were reported in the second quarter (April–June) this year, lower than the 333 in the first quarter and far below the 7,554 in the same period last year. More than 70% of cases are in the 15-and-over group. The region reported 11 infant deaths last year. Vaccination rates among pregnant women and infants have declined in recent years, but after last year's deaths, the vaccination rate among pregnant women has risen back to 73%, still below the peak of 76%. Réunion (France) has an outbreak: 70 cases have been cumulatively reported this year, 17 more than in the same period last year. About 36% of cases are children under 5, and severe cases have been reported, including one death. Authorities urge vaccination.

zekEQCwJMOQXY8FKV6j3Lg.zh: 美洲疫情更新,今年截至第30週共11國累計報告12,786例確診病例,其中,巴西11,888例(5例死亡)、巴拿馬501例、秘魯330例、古巴28例、哥倫比亞26例、委內瑞拉5例、蓋亞那1例、烏拉圭3例(境外移入)、智利2例(境外移入)、美國及加拿大各1例(境外移入)。受到氣候變遷等因素導致病媒─帕拉庫蠓孳生,進而造成病毒傳播至非流行地區(如古巴市區)。此外,英國亦報告3例病例,均有巴西旅遊史。去年美洲地區累計報告16,239例確診病例(4例死亡),歐洲地區亦報告30例境外移入病例。
zekEQCwJMOQXY8FKV6j3Lg.en: Americas outbreak update: as of week 30 this year, 11 countries had cumulatively reported 12,786 confirmed cases: Brazil 11,888 (5 deaths), Panama 501, Peru 330, Cuba 28, Colombia 26, Venezuela 5, Guyana 1, Uruguay 3 (imported), Chile 2 (imported), and the USA and Canada 1 each (imported). Climate change and other factors have led to proliferation of the vector, the Culicoides paraensis midge, which has spread the virus to non-endemic areas such as central Havana, Cuba. In addition, the UK reported three cases, all with travel history to Brazil. Last year, the Americas cumulatively reported 16,239 confirmed cases (4 deaths), and Europe also reported 30 imported cases.

INK9QIjivlSTTc5aJxESkg.zh: 本月更新:  全球自2022年6月截至今年7/25累計139國/地區報告15萬4千餘例確診病例,其中至少385例死亡(CFR:0.2%)。 全球今年截至第30週累計79國/地區報告3萬3,370例確診病例,其中非洲區2萬8,481例、美洲區2,343例、歐洲區1,706例、西太平洋區755例、東南亞區52例及東地中海區33例。  其他更新:  中國今年截至7/31報告23例Ib型確診病例,其中7例具疫區旅遊史,包含烏干達(2例)、坦尚亞(2例)、剛果民主共和國(2例)、西非國家(剛果、馬利),另2例具泊爾及1例具阿拉伯聯合大公國旅遊史,其餘個案為本土傳播,其中,包含居住在中國之非洲僑民。WHO基於所有通報群聚事件中,指標個案均能與旅遊史有流行病學關聯,故將該國傳播分類由「未知傳播鏈」更正為「與旅遊相關個案」,惟仍無法排除尚未偵測到之社區傳播可能性。當局已在疫區進行廢水監測,並加強衛教及提供無症狀者藥物。 澳大利亞7/19報告新增2例Ib型病例,案1近期有烏干達旅遊史,案2為案1家庭接觸者,當局已加強監測疫情。 英國7/22新增1例Ib型病例,為成年男性,具肯亞旅遊史,當局已展開疫調與監測,並提供接觸者疫苗。  評估與建議: WHO於2025年6月5日召開國際衛生條例(IHR)緊急委員會第四次會議,討論2024年M痘疫情上升的情形。會議確認該事件仍構成國際關注公共衛生緊急事件(PHEIC),並針對受影響國家提出各項臨時建議,包括加強監測、提升診斷能力、推動疫苗接種、改善臨床護理、強化跨境合作,以及加強社區參與和資金支持,並將現行建議延長至2025年8月20日。
INK9QIjivlSTTc5aJxESkg.en: Monthly update: since June 2022 and as of 25 July this year, 139 countries and territories have cumulatively reported more than 154,000 confirmed cases, of which at least 385 died (CFR: 0.2%). This year, as of week 30, 79 countries and territories have cumulatively reported 33,370 confirmed cases: African Region 28,481; Region of the Americas 2,343; European Region 1,706; Western Pacific Region 755; South-East Asia Region 52; and Eastern Mediterranean Region 33. Other updates: China reported 23 confirmed clade Ib cases as of 31 July this year, of which seven had travel history to affected areas, including Uganda (2), Tanzania (2), the DRC (2), and West African countries (Congo, Mali); two had travel history to Nepal and one to the UAE. The other cases were locally transmitted, including African nationals living in China. Based on all reported clusters in which the index cases had epidemiological links to travel, WHO has reclassified China's transmission category from 'unknown transmission chain' to 'travel-associated cases', although undetected community transmission cannot be ruled out. Authorities have launched wastewater surveillance in affected areas, strengthened health education, and provided medicines to asymptomatic people. Australia reported two new clade Ib cases on 19 July: case 1 had recent travel history to Uganda, and case 2 was a household contact of case 1; authorities have strengthened surveillance. The UK reported one new clade Ib case on 22 July, an adult male with travel history to Kenya; authorities have launched epidemiological investigation and surveillance and provided vaccines to contacts. Assessment and recommendations: WHO held the fourth meeting of the IHR Emergency Committee on 5 June 2025 to discuss the rise in mpox since 2024. The meeting confirmed that the event still constitutes a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC), and issued temporary recommendations for affected countries, including strengthening surveillance, improving diagnostic capacity, promoting vaccination, improving clinical care, strengthening cross-border cooperation, and enhancing community engagement and financial support. Current recommendations were extended to 20 August 2025.

3nkSQVZOk4BA2gLUpTyCXw.zh: 加拿大今年截至7/5共10省報告3,822例,其中以安大略省及亞伯達省為多,亞伯達省病例數上升,截至7/14報告逾1,200例,當地疫情嚴峻,該省已針對南部及北部部分地區發布警報,由於夏季大型集會增加及學校即將開學,預期疫情風險將持續。 美國今年迄今共39州報告1,288例,已報告27起疫情,病例數已超過2019年全年病例數,為該國宣布消除麻疹以來最高紀錄,該國有近1/3病例為20歲以上成人,92%個案未接種疫苗或接種史不明,自德州於今年1月發生大規模疫情後,已有多個州爆發小規模疫情,同時有大量境外移入個案。 韓國今年截至7/5累計報告65例,所有病例皆為境外移入及其相關個案,感染地以越南(42例)為多,餘有烏茲別克、義大利、泰國及蒙古等國,病患多為19歲以上成年人。 英國利物浦報告1例兒童死亡案例,為英蘭地區近5年來第2例死亡,前1例為2023年大曼徹斯特10歲女童,英蘭地區今年迄今報告529例,以倫敦都會區為多,該地區去年報告2,900餘例,為2012年以來新高。
3nkSQVZOk4BA2gLUpTyCXw.en: Canada has reported 3,822 cases in 10 provinces as of 5 July this year, mainly in Ontario and Alberta. Alberta's case count has risen, with more than 1,200 cases reported as of 14 July. The epidemic there is severe, and the province has issued alerts for parts of the south and north. Because of increased large summer gatherings and the imminent start of school, the risk is expected to continue. The United States has reported 1,288 cases in 39 states so far this year, with 27 outbreaks reported. The number of cases has already exceeded the total for all of 2019, the highest since the country declared measles eliminated. Nearly one third of cases are adults aged over 20, and 92% of cases were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination history. Since a large outbreak in Texas in January this year, several states have experienced small outbreaks, alongside many imported cases. South Korea reported 65 cases as of 5 July this year, all imported or linked to imported cases. Most were from Viet Nam (42 cases), with others from Uzbekistan, Italy, Thailand and Mongolia, and most patients were adults aged 19 and over. In Liverpool, United Kingdom, one child died; this is the second death in England in five years, the previous being a 10-year-old girl in Greater Manchester in 2023. England has reported 529 cases so far this year, mainly in Greater London. England reported more than 2,900 cases last year, the highest since 2012.

g45biwqn8p7NoSgSXUqOJw.zh: 英國報告1例境外移入死亡病例,為59歲女性,於今(2025)年2月前往摩洛哥旅遊期間遭犬隻抓傷,於6月上旬出現頭痛、無法行走、說話、睡覺及吞嚥等症狀後死亡。該國於2020-24年累計報告6例境外移入病例,當局呼籲民眾前往高風險國家應儘可能避免接觸犬貓及其他動物,並於旅行前諮詢是否需要接種狂犬病疫苗。
g45biwqn8p7NoSgSXUqOJw.en: The United Kingdom reported an imported death: a 59-year-old woman who was scratched by a dog during a trip to Morocco in February this year. In early June she developed headache and was unable to walk, speak, sleep or swallow, and she died. The UK recorded 6 imported cases cumulatively in 2020–24. Authorities urge people travelling to high-risk countries to avoid contact with dogs, cats and other animals as far as possible, and to consult before travel about whether rabies vaccination is needed.

DvLdkYIyc2c_yOeMYEiinA.zh: 全球疫情更新,匈牙利疫情嚴峻,今年截至5月累計報告641例病例,為去年同期7倍;英國於6/12公布近期累計95例病例,其中58例住院,經調查推估有兩起群聚事件,其中1起之感染源為超市食品;印度南部喀拉拉邦(Kerala)於6/11報告51例病例,其中21例來自同一地區,懷疑為相同感染源,當局已發布疫情警報;中國今年截至5月累計報告近1萬例病例,為去年同期1.5倍。
DvLdkYIyc2c_yOeMYEiinA.en: Global update: Hungary's outbreak is severe. As of May this year, 641 cases have been reported cumulatively, 7 times the same period last year. On 12 June, the UK published that 95 recent cases had been reported cumulatively, 58 of whom were hospitalized. Investigation estimates two clusters, one of which had a food source from a supermarket. In Kerala State in southern India, 51 cases were reported on 11 June, 21 of them from the same area; they are suspected to share the same source, and authorities have issued an outbreak alert. China reported nearly 10,000 cumulative cases as of May this year, 1.5 times the same period last year.

z73KtW0eCTm4QsLTiuygtA.zh: 英國今年截至3月累計報告與旅遊相關共84例傷寒,以及39例副傷寒病例,另該國2024年傷寒/副傷寒合計報告702例病例,高於2023年8%,為史上新高;當局提醒於巴基斯坦流行之抗藥性菌株,呼籲民眾旅行前應接種傷寒疫苗。
z73KtW0eCTm4QsLTiuygtA.en: The UK has reported 84 travel-associated typhoid cases and 39 paratyphoid cases cumulatively this year as of March. In 2024 the UK reported a combined 702 typhoid and paratyphoid cases, 8% higher than in 2023 and a record high. Authorities warn of drug-resistant strains prevalent in Pakistan and urge travellers to receive typhoid vaccination before travel.

56h2uqfEt6Z_ZOlIbdofJg.zh: 德國巴伐利亞邦爆發疫情,共報告18例,病例皆與當地5月初舉行之國際活動相關,其中12例為來自波蘭/義大利/捷克/英國之民眾;玻利維亞東部聖克魯斯省報告7例,指標病例為22歲男性,具傳染力期間曾參加大型宗教集會,因具社區傳播風險,當局發布衛生警示。隨北半球夏季即將到來,預期旅遊及大型活動增加,將提升疾病傳播及跨境感染風險。 美國亞利桑納州報告該州今年首起疫情,4例病患來自該州東部納瓦荷郡,皆未接種疫苗,近期有境外旅遊史,均來自同一感染源;該國截至6/5共34州報告17起疫情,累計1,168例病例,其中137例住院及3例死亡。
56h2uqfEt6Z_ZOlIbdofJg.en: An outbreak in Bavaria, Germany, has reported 18 cases, all linked to an international event held locally in early May; 12 of the cases were people from Poland, Italy, the Czech Republic and the United Kingdom. In Santa Cruz Department in eastern Bolivia, 7 cases have been reported. The index case was a 22-year-old man who attended a large religious gathering during his infectious period. Because of the risk of community transmission, authorities have issued a health alert. As the northern hemisphere summer approaches, travel and large events are expected to increase, raising the risk of disease spread and cross-border infection. In the United States, Arizona reported the state's first outbreak this year: 4 patients from Navajo County in the east of the state, all unvaccinated, with recent overseas travel, all from the same source. Authorities say resistant cases are mostly linked to travel in the Asia-Pacific region, and have issued treatment guidelines for drug-resistant gonorrhoea.

Nfo_A9LwasAwfLVfxp5WLA.en: Brazil's Amazonas State outbreak is rising: as of April this year, 33 cases have been reported cumulatively, mostly in men aged 30–39. Authorities will continue preventive measures. The state reported only 10 cases for the whole of 2023. Neighboring Pará State reported 19 cases as of 28 April this year, including 2 deaths. Sierra Leone's outbreak continues: as of 8 May, 1,603 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively, including 11 deaths. Most cases are clade IIb men aged 30–35, distributed in the west of the country, including the capital Freetown. Outbreaks in some high-burden African countries, such as the Democratic Republic of the Congo, have slowed. The UK reported on 8 May that from October 2024 to 30 April 2025, 12 clade Ib cases had been reported cumulatively, most of which were directly or indirectly linked to travel to affected areas. In addition, from 2023 to 30 April 2025, 508 clade IIb cases were reported cumulatively, mostly among men who have sex with men (MSM).

T5o1icBBPBJGiEF_BfKr8A.zh: 本週摘要:  人類疫情:本週無新增人類感染病例。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS): 共8國於2025/2/17-4/28期間新增52起H5N1疫情,美國17起、韓國12起、英國11起、德國/波蘭各4起、匈牙利2起、孟加拉/丹麥各1起。 共2國於2025/3/17-4/11期間新增2起H5N5疫情,挪威/英國各1起。 日本於2025/4/25新增1起H3N8疫情。  美國乳牛感染禽流感案:  乳牛場:去年3月迄今累計17州報告1,048 (17)起疫情,近期主要集中於愛達荷州、加州及亞利桑那州。 人類經牛感染:累計監測至少9,300例,檢測218例,其中41例陽性(結膜炎、呼吸道及流感症狀)。 其他衍生疫情:感染家貓/羊/羊駝等,其中出現貓隻死亡案例。 廢水監測:第17週計407個採檢點提供檢測報告,其中,3州(加州、奧勒岡州、紐澤西州)5個採檢點檢出H5陽性。  其他更新:  美國CDC於5月2日更新流感風險評估工具(IRAT),將兩種新H5N1病毒列入評估名單:A/California/147/2024(基因型B3.13)及A/Washington/239/2024(基因型D1.1),兩病毒均屬H5N1 2.3.4.4b群,並被評為「中度風險」,近於先前被評估之其他 H5N1病毒。 期刊於4/28評論,來自40多國專家呼籲各國應加強監測、增強生物安全及新興傳染病整備計畫,以應對H5N1流感威脅,美國自2024年迄今超過995起乳牛場疫情及至少70例人類病例,並包含多起重症及該國首例死亡病例,部分人類病例未曾接觸感染動物,顯示病毒可能發生適應,並具有人際傳播潛力,另病毒持續於野鳥、家禽及被狩獵候鳥中傳播,亦增加人類及家畜風險。持續投入人畜監測資源,即時分享現地異常資訊及病毒基因學資料,對於掌握病毒動態至關重要。  年度摘要:  人類病例: H5N1流感10例 (2003年迄今累計973*例)、H9N2流感3例(迄今累計131例),個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。(依WHO統計方式將美國H5流感病例列為H5N1流感病例。) 禽類/動物案例:累計51國家/地區通報1,656起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  評估與建議:FAO/WHO/WOAH於4/17針對H5流感病毒發表風險評估,目前H5 2.3.4.4b病毒仍屬禽類病毒,人類病例多曾直/間接接觸易感動物,且未發生人際傳播能力,基於病毒廣泛存在於野生及飼養動物中,預期仍會持續出現病例,評估全球公共衛生風險仍低;感染風險部分,於一般大眾仍低,於常接觸受汙染動物或環境者則為低至中,主要因素為接觸的方式、時間、防護及管控措施等,呼籲各國加強對易感染動物及高危險人群之監測。
T5o1icBBPBJGiEF_BfKr8A.en: Summary for this week: Human cases: no new human infections were reported this week. Animal and poultry outbreaks (WAHIS): a total of 8 countries reported 52 new H5N1 outbreaks between 17 February and 28 April 2025: the United States 17, South Korea 12, the United Kingdom 11, Germany and Poland 4 each, Hungary 2, and Bangladesh and Denmark 1 each. A total of 2 countries reported 2 new H5N5 outbreaks between 17 March and 11 April 2025: Norway and the United Kingdom 1 each. Japan reported 1 new H3N8 outbreak on 25 April 2025. Avian influenza in US dairy cattle: Herds: since March last year, 1,048 (17) outbreaks have been reported cumulatively across 17 states, with recent cases concentrated in Idaho, California and Arizona. Human infection via cattle: at least 9,300 cases have been monitored cumulatively, 218 tested, of which 41 were positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms). Other derived outbreaks: infections in domestic cats, sheep, alpacas and others, including a cat death. Wastewater surveillance: in week 17, 407 sampling sites provided test reports, and 5 sampling sites in 3 states (California, Oregon and New Jersey) detected H5-positive results. Other updates: on 2 May the US CDC updated its Influenza Risk Assessment Tool (IRAT), adding two new H5N1 viruses to the assessment list: A/California/147/2024 (genotype B3.13) and A/Washington/239/2024 (genotype D1.1). Both viruses belong to the H5N1 2.3.4.4b clade and were rated as moderate risk, close to other H5N1 viruses previously assessed. A journal commentary published on 28 April by experts from more than 40 countries called on countries to strengthen surveillance, enhance biosecurity and improve preparedness for emerging infectious diseases in response to the H5N1 threat. Since 2024 the US has reported more than 995 dairy herd outbreaks and at least 70 human cases, including several severe cases and the country's first death; some human cases had no contact with infected animals, suggesting the virus may be adapting and may have the potential for human-to-human transmission. The virus also continues to spread among wild birds, poultry and hunted migratory birds, increasing risks to humans and livestock. Continued investment in human and animal surveillance resources, and timely sharing of local abnormal information and viral genetic data, are essential for understanding virus dynamics. Annual summary: Human cases: 10 H5N1 influenza cases (973* cumulative since 2003) and 3 H9N2 influenza cases (131 cumulative); most cases had prior exposure to susceptible animals. (Following WHO counting methods, US H5 influenza cases are classified as H5N1 influenza cases.) Avian and animal cases: 1,656 highly and low pathogenic avian influenza outbreaks have been reported cumulatively by 51 countries and regions. Assessment and recommendations: FAO, WHO and WOAH published a risk assessment on H5 influenza viruses on 17 April. Currently, H5 2.3.4.4b viruses are still avian viruses; most human cases had direct or indirect contact with susceptible animals, and no human-to-human transmission has occurred. Because the virus is widespread in wild and farmed animals, cases are expected to continue, and the global public health risk is assessed as low. For infection risk, the risk is low for the general public and low to moderate for people who frequently contact contaminated animals or environments; the main factors are the mode and duration of contact, protective measures and control measures. Countries are urged to strengthen surveillance of susceptible animals and high-risk groups.

bjd7Ue6BgaDQlPXFrX7F_w.en: Monthly update: as of 20 April this year, 132 countries and regions have reported 138,085 confirmed mpox cases cumulatively since May 2022, including at least 317 deaths (CFR 0.2%). As of week 16 this year, 68 countries and regions have reported 17,373 confirmed cases cumulatively this year: 14,564 in the African Region, 1,500 in the Region of the Americas, 344 in the Western Pacific Region, 913 in the European Region, 26 in the South-East Asia Region and 26 in the Eastern Mediterranean Region. Other updates: WHO reported that between 28 March and 20 April, 4 countries (the United Kingdom, France, Switzerland and Thailand) reported 4 new clade Ib cases, and China reported 2 new clade Ia cases; most had travel history to Central Africa. Assessment and recommendations: WHO held the third meeting of the IHR Emergency Committee on the 2024 mpox outbreak on 25 February 2025. It stated that the outbreak remains severe, the scale of the outbreak in countries including the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) remains unclear, the number of countries reporting clade Ib infections has multiplied internationally, and reduced funding is affecting access to vaccine and diagnostic resources. It therefore declared that this wave of the outbreak continues to constitute a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). Risk assessment by clade: clade Ia, transmission risk in the DRC is moderate; clade Ib, transmission risk in the DRC and neighboring areas is high; clade II, transmission risk in Nigeria and across Central and West Africa is moderate; clade IIb, international transmission risk is moderate.

Salmonella infection cases in England also increased year by year, from 8,290 in 2022 to nearly 10,400 in 2024, with a peak in September. Patients are mainly aged 0–9, and London has the most cases. v780hgwLFQYBCmZCGQnWAQ.en: Europe has reported 7 cholera cases in 2 countries from the start of this year to the end of February: 4 in the United Kingdom and 3 in Germany. The patients had travelled to Ethiopia or had consumed holy water from the Amhara Region of Ethiopia. Five cases reported drinking bottled water from an affected area, and the bottled water also tested positive for the pathogen. Authorities warn that travellers to Ethiopia, and bottled water from the affected areas, carry a risk of infection. Cholera in Angola continues to rise. Since the outbreak was declared on 7 January, 5,872 cases have been reported cumulatively from 13 provinces as of mid-March, including 937 confirmed cases and 208 deaths. Children under 15 account for 39% of cases and 35% of deaths.

LbS0yCDa_5udQCCaiSlU7Q.zh: 英國3/24公布,於英蘭東北部約克郡某農場發現全球首例綿羊感染H5N1流感,該農場禽鳥曾感染禽流感,於例行監測時,發現染疫羊隻之羊乳呈陽性,血液樣本亦呈現H5抗體陽性,並有乳腺炎症狀,為防止疫情擴散,已撲殺該羊隻,目前場內其他羊隻並未檢出感染。當局表示,於全球範圍內仍可能持續發現哺乳動物感染H5N1流感,目前證據顯示現存病毒不易傳播予人類,對公眾風險仍極低,另食品標準局表示,該病毒通常不會經由食物傳播,評估禽流感對消費者的食品安全風險仍極低。
LbS0yCDa_5udQCCaiSlU7Q.en: On 24 March the UK announced the world's first case of H5N1 avian influenza infection in sheep, found on a farm in Yorkshire in northeastern England. The farm's birds had previously been infected with avian influenza. During routine surveillance, the milk of an infected ewe tested positive, and blood samples showed positive H5 antibodies, with mastitis symptoms. To prevent spread, the infected sheep was culled, and no other sheep on the farm have tested positive so far. Authorities say mammal infections with H5N1 may continue to be found globally. Current evidence suggests the virus does not spread easily to humans, and the risk to the public remains very low. The Food Standards Agency says the virus is not normally transmitted through food, and assesses the food safety risk of avian influenza to consumers as very low.

6sTtvZ9Cz-vjFw9AO5lVcA.en: On 19 March the UK reported an outbreak linked to medical and long-term care facilities from May to December last year, with 5 cumulative cases, 3 of whom died. z7UFQ_w1WyP7B04paDqCjw.en: Texas, USA: the outbreak continues to expand. As of 25 February, 124 cases had been reported in 9 counties, of which 18 were hospitalized. Most patients were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination status. Gaines County currently has the most cases, with 80. Lea County in neighbouring New Mexico has reported 9 cases cumulatively. Canada: southeastern Canada has more cases than usual. Ontario has reported 57 confirmed and 6 suspected cases cumulatively this year, and Quebec has reported 27 cases cumulatively since December last year. New Brunswick has had an outbreak since October last year, which has affected surrounding areas to date. Canada's annual case numbers over the past decade have ranged from 0 to 418; the historical high was 751 in 2011, and more than 70 cases had been reported cumulatively this year as of mid-February. England, UK: 91 confirmed cases have been reported this year, mainly in Yorkshire and the Humber and the South West. England reported over 2,900 cases in 2024, the highest since 2012. Large outbreaks occurred in Birmingham and London last year, with small clusters elsewhere. The outbreak has eased since July last year, although small-scale outbreaks continue in some areas. Scotland has reported 17 cases this year as of 19 February; it reported 1 case in 2023 and 24 in 2024.

JnaKcCoFR_36KooLFEVHOw.zh: 歐洲報告自今年1月截至2/6,檢測出有相同基因關聯的菌株(Shigella sonnei ST152)聚集,顯示有相同的感染來源,分別為英國報告20例、奧地利/法國均為7例、荷蘭1例,其中27例有國際旅遊史,主要於亞洲國家旅行。病患介於15-70歲,多數為女性。發病期間為1/8-17,感染源仍不明,ECDC評估可能有國際間旅行傳播的可能性。
JnaKcCoFR_36KooLFEVHOw.en: From January to 6 February, Europe detected a cluster of strains with the same genetic link (Shigella sonnei ST152), indicating a common source of infection: the UK reported 20 cases, Austria and France 7 each, and the Netherlands 1. Situation update: In week 46 of 2024 (11–17 November), the global positivity rate was about 12.8%, highest in the European Region (13.7%), the Region of the Americas (10.6%) and the African Region (5.0%).

The United Kingdom has seen several recent indicators decline. In week 48 (25 November–1 December), hospital admission rates and numbers of admissions were at low levels. Authorities urge people to get COVID-19 and influenza vaccines as soon as possible to reduce the risk of respiratory infections.

Japan reported 13,583 new cases in week 48 (25 November–1 December), up from 11,499 in the previous week (18–24 November). Hospital admissions also rose compared with the previous week, with notable increases in case numbers in Hokkaido and the Tohoku region. Cases are expected to keep rising, and authorities have expanded preparations for the winter season.

Assessment and recommendations: Global positivity has been stable recently, with slight increases in the African Region and South-East Asia Region, while other regions show stable or declining trends. KP.3.1.1 remains the main circulating variant globally, and the share of XEC variants is increasing, but this has not yet increased disease severity. WHO notes that most countries have now included COVID-19 in routine respiratory infection surveillance. WHO recommends that countries provide affordable and trustworthy testing, treatment and vaccines, maintain early warning and surveillance systems, keep tracking variant trends, report epidemic information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure built during the COVID-19 period.
